As far as I can tell the panel that was added in commit da50bd4258db
(""drm/panel: simple: Add Innolux TV123WAM panel driver support"")
wasn't actually an Innolux TV123WAM but was actually an Innolux
P120ZDG-BF1.
As far as I can tell the Innolux TV123WAM isn't a real panel and but
it's a mosh between the TI TV123WAM and the Innolux P120ZDG-BF1.
Let's unmosh.
Here's my evidence:
* Searching for TV123WAM on the Internet turns up a TI panel.  While
it's possible that an Innolux panel has the same model number as the
TI Panel
column2: it seems a little doubtful.  Looking up the datasheet from

column1: the TI Panel shows that it's 1920 x 1280 and 259.2 mm x 172.8 mm.
* As far as I know
column2: the patch adding the Innolux Panel was supposed to

column1: be for the board that's sitting in front of me as I type this
(support for that board is not yet upstream).  On the back of that
panel I see Innolux P120ZDZ-EZ1 rev B1.
* Someone pointed me at a datasheet that's supposed to be for the
panel in front of me (sorry
column2: I can't share the datasheet).  That

column1: datasheet has the string ""p120zdg-bf1""
* If I search for ""P120ZDG-BF1"" on the Internet I get hits for panels
that are 2160x1440.  They don't have datasheets
the resolution matches is a good sign.
In any case
column2: let's update the name and also the physical size to match

column1: the correct panel.
